description: Guardian Risk Gate — optional technical enforcement layer. Before any shell command runs, it checks whether it matches the 'critical operations' list (rm -rf, git reset --hard, push --force, DROP DATABASE, etc.) and, if so, forces a real user confirmation through Claude Code's permission system — it does not depend on the model deciding to ask. Invoked with 'bash' (no execute bit needed) and, if the hook fails, it blocks instead of letting the command through (onFailure: block, Claude Code v2.1.295+).
